title: Locale-aware pricing ribbons + deprecation timeline frames for model catalog release visuals
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Design and produce a set of localized pricing ribbons and deprecation timeline frames for the model catalog section of the upcoming release notes. Deliverables include desktop/mobile/light/dark screenshots, brief motion frames (micro-animations) for the deprecation banner, and annotated export-ready assets for engineering and docs. Focus on clarity for new model launch and end-of-life (EOL) states across locales (en-US, en-GB, de-DE, ja-JP) and currency displays.
background: Previous release screenshots were single-locale and hard-coded price badges which caused confusion in localized markets and in audit logs. Engineering requests flexible image variants and small GIFs for deprecation animations. Docs wants consistent hero screenshots for the release notes page and a compact mobile stack for the quickstart flow.
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots exported in PNG 2x and SVG where applicable
Pricing ribbons show correct localized currency formats for en-US, en-GB, de-DE, ja-JP
Deprecation timeline visuals include a 1.5s micro-animation GIF and a static frame fallback
Contrast and WCAG AA compliance for all badges and banners in both light and dark themes
Assets uploaded to Drive and referenced in the release PR with file names following catalog_v2025_11_<locale>_<variant>.*
tasks: Finalize ribbon copy and currency formatting with PM
Create dark-mode color token mapping and verify with accessibility team
Build 1.5s micro-animation in Figma prototyping then export as GIF
Prepare static fallback frames and name per export convention
Upload assets to Drive and add links to release PR
Add image references to release-notes draft in Confluence
